newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Southern Bank revises rights price.
newsitem.headline: Southern Bank revises rights price.

text.p: Malaysia's Southern Bank Bhd said on Wednesday that the price of its planned one-for-two rights issue has been lowered to 2.50 ringgit from 2.85 ringgit a share.
But the proposed issue of up to 299.77 million new shares for the rights, and another 199.85 million new shares for a separate one-for-two bonus will be retained, the bank said in a statement.
It said the revision was to take into account current market prices of its share price.
Southern Bank stock closed Wednesday trading at 5.90 ringgit, against 7.30 ringgit when the rights issue was first announced on March 24.
Proceeds of up to 749.4 million ringgit from the rights issue will be used to finance its contuining growth, the statement said.
